design: Head6 only, same H413 panel/H416 maps/H410 groups. Actual, raw, norm-only, angle-only, both. Double input RMS derivative with native float32 epsilon; fixed native baseline output metric. Decompose each group into fixed-scale bilinear and input-RMS radial parts, expand core/add cross into FF,FR,RF,RR. Common original-full Fisher denominator per condition. Joint4 band for two angle effects and radial-associated contribution fractions at donor/recipient norms. No semantic/unique mediation claim.
